text:
Maya: Heads-up — rolling out session-affinity-v2 today. Plan is laddered percent ramp across cohorts. Deploy window 09:30-10:15 PT.

Oliver: I'm on deploy. Will kick at 09:30 PT and monitor first 1% cohort.

Jen: I'll own smoke and metrics during the ramp. Quick checklist posted below.

Satya: FYI I'll be available for rollback if we hit threshold. Ping me with a :rotating_light:.

Ava: Couple quick asks: which cohorts/regions for the micro-ramp? Also, do we have the feature-flag toggle ready?

Oliver: Cohorts: 1) us-west-small (1%) -> 2) us-east-small (5%) -> 3) eu-central (20%) -> 4) global 50% -> 100%. Feature flag `session-affinity-v2` is on in the console, can be flipped to partial by region.

Kai: Noted. I'll keep an eye on the network LB sticky-session errors.

Jen: Smoke checklist (short):
- /health returns 200
- synthetic user flow completes (login->search->generate) within 2s median
- p50/p95 latency within baseline +20%
- error rate spike < 0.5% absolute
- queue/backpressure metrics normal

Maya: Rollback thresholds agreed: if error > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes OR p95 > 2x baseline for 5 minutes, we stop and roll back to session-affinity-v1.

Oliver: Deploy steps (short):
1) kubectl apply -f k8s/session-affinity-v2.yaml
2) deploy-bot will announce rollout start
3) run `kubectl rollout status deploy/session-affinity --timeout=5m`
4) check canary logs `stern session-affinity -n prod --since 2m`

deploy-bot: Deployer Oliver started rollout for prod/session-affinity-v2 at 09:31:12 UTC. Rollout id: r-4132106789-oliver

Jen: First cohort up (us-west-small). smoke run 09:33 PT: health ok, synthetic flow ok, p95 = baseline+12%, errors 0.12% — :thumbsup:

Oliver: Moving to us-east-small -> 5% at 09:40 PT. Keeping 15m guard on first two cohorts.

Ava: Watching infra — no autoscaler thrash, CPU steady. No 5xx spikes.

Kai: Saw a transient 502 at 09:42 PT for a single instance during startup, recovered within 30s. Noting but below threshold.

Jen: us-east smoke pass. p95 18% above baseline, error 0.18%. Proceeding to eu-central 20% at 09:55 PT.

Maya: Reminder: if alerting fires, call rollback and tag ops-oncall. Satya, keep phone ready.

Satya: Got it. Oncall informed.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-4132106789-oliver: reached 20% in eu-central at 09:57:48 UTC.

Jen: eu-central metrics drifting: p95 32% above baseline, error 0.6% sustained for 4 minutes -> hitting rollback threshold. Initiating rollback now.

Oliver: Acknowledged. Rolling back to session-affinity-v1 and pausing further ramps.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by Oliver for rollout r-4132106789-oliver at 10:02:10 UTC. Status: in-progress.

Maya: Good catch team. Postmortem follow-up: collect logs for failed instances + trace spans for 09:50-10:05 PT. Assigning to Jen and Kai to triage, Oliver to hold off re-deploy.

Jen: Will aggregate smoke artifacts and post a short thread in #incidents with traces.

Kai: I'll snapshot LB logs and connection traces.

Ava: I'll open a quick PR to add a short-lived guard in the flag rollout that keeps eu-central capped unless perf targets met.

Maya: Thanks. Closing loop: rollback complete at 10:08 PT, feature flag set back to stable. We'll reconvene async with root cause and next steps. :white_check_mark:
